title: EFLU students detained while protesting a talk by an RSS leader on campus
seoTitle: Hyderabad EFLU students' protest over RSS talk

tea.why: Students objected to the university allowing a talk on campus by a Telangana RSS functionary.
tea.want: That the EFLU administration withdraw permission for the programme.
tea.changed: Sept 30: police placed 12 students, including six student union leaders, in preventive detention.

summary: Twelve students of the English and Foreign Languages University (EFLU) in Hyderabad, including six student union leaders, were placed in preventive detention on September 30 while protesting a talk on campus by a Telangana RSS prant pracharak. The event, titled 'Yuva Sankalp: Empowering Youth for Nation Building', was organised by the Bhagat Singh Youth Club. The student union, which includes the Fraternity Movement, Muslim Students Federation and NSUI, said it protested after the administration refused to withdraw permission for the programme.
demands: Withdraw permission for the RSS functionary's talk on campus
response: The EFLU administration declined to withdraw permission; police placed 12 students in preventive detention.

updates.text: Students protested the talk; 12 were placed in preventive detention.
